name: Benchmark v2 (SWE-Lancer)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      exercise:
        description: 'Task ID (e.g. 16912_4)'

        type: string

        description: 'Agent name'

        description: 'Timeout in seconds (default: 3600)'

        type: number
        default: 3600
      v2_setup_wait_seconds:
        description: 'V2 setup wait time in seconds (default: 900)'
        required: false
        type: number
        default: 900

env:
  TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC: ${{ github.event.inputs.v2_setup_wait_seconds }}
  TS_BENCH_TIMEOUT_SEC: ${{ github.event.inputs.timeout_seconds }}

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    concurrency:
      group: benchmark-v2-${{ github.repository }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - name: Disk cleanup
        run: |
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet
          sudo rm -rf /opt/ghc
          sudo rm -rf "/usr/local/share/boost"
          sudo rm -rf "$AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY"
          sudo apt-get clean
          sudo apt-get autoremove -y

      - name: Checkout repository with LFS
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          lfs: true
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Pull SWE-Lancer Docker image
        run: docker pull swelancer/swelancer_x86_monolith:releasev1

      - name: Create patches directory
        run: mkdir -p .patches

      - name: Run benchmark
        run: |
          bun src/index.ts \
            --dataset v2 \
            --docker \
            --exercise ${{ github.event.inputs.exercise }} \
            --agent ${{ github.event.inputs.agent }} \
            --provider ${{ github.event.inputs.provider }} \
            --model ${{ github.event.inputs.model }} \
            --timeout ${{ env.TS_BENCH_TIMEOUT_SEC }}
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-results
          path: |
            data/results/
            results/
            logs/
            benchmark-summary.txt
            .patches/
